summary: Audited main@0c4fb05 for dataset-scale (108,501/97,698/20,000+) and UTKFace claims. No "20,000+" hits anywhere. Dataset-scale: 2 STALE (report/src/backmatter/back.tex:20, and its compiled main.pdf p.36) still say 108,501 unqualified; docs/BiasAperture-AT.md (3 lines) and research/context feed/BiasAperture-AT.md (dup) uncorrected; research/research tracks/{CONTEXT.md,track_02,track_03,track_07,track_34} still carry pre-verification 108,501 as "current". All docs/, dev-logs/, README.md, CLAUDE.md, requirements.tex, CLAIM_LEDGER.md correctly show 97,698 (86,744+10,954), several properly caveated with the 108,501-was-pre-discard note. UTKFace: report/main.tex proposal chapters (conclusion.tex:6, intro.tex:26/33/36, systemArchitectureAndMethodology.tex:46/75, abstract.tex:4) still frame UTKFace as an active co-validated dataset — never updated post Cut-List #2 execution, so report/main.pdf itself is stale on this point even though requirements.tex:188's own cut-list table (in the same document) correctly lists it as cut. context-summary/high-level-summary.md also omits cut status. All CLAUDE.md/README.md/specs/docs/research artifacts correctly show UTKFace as [CUT]/profiled-only.
